subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We wanted to confirm that your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on August 15th has been successfully processed. Your e-ticket and itinerary have been sent to your email for your reference. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for a smooth check-in process. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
